Diagnosis:
CAUSE: Deployment `catalog` in namespace `shop` points its pod template at image `docker.io/library/nginx:1.99`, a tag that does not exist in the registry, so pod `catalog-6b8cf764b7-xvrnl` stays in ImagePullBackOff and its container `catalog` never starts.

EVIDENCE:
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop pod catalog-6b8cf764b7-xvrnl`: container `catalog` is Waiting with Reason `ImagePullBackOff`, Image `docker.io/library/nginx:1.99`, Restart Count 0, Ready False, Status Pending. (Verified by me.)
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop pod catalog-6b8cf764b7-xvrnl` (Events): `Failed to pull image "docker.io/library/nginx:1.99": rpc error: code = NotFound desc = failed to pull and unpack image "docker.io/library/nginx:1.99": failed to resolve reference ... docker.io/library/nginx:1.99: not found`, followed by `Error: ErrImagePull` and `Error: ImagePullBackOff`. (Verified by me.)
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get -n shop events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp` (diag-k8s): the same NotFound error also appears for the earlier pod `catalog-6b8cf764b7-dcbx7` about 59 minutes ago, so this tag has never pulled.
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get -n shop rs -l app=catalog -o custom-columns=...` (diag-k8s): the only ReplicaSet is `catalog-6b8cf764b7` at REVISION 1, CHANGE-CAUSE `<none>`, DESIRED 1, IMAGE `docker.io/library/nginx:1.99`. No earlier revision exists, so no previous revision ever ran.
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop deployment catalog` (diag-k8s): pod template image `docker.io/library/nginx:1.99`, Available False (MinimumReplicasUnavailable), OldReplicaSets `<none>`, revision annotation 1.
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab logs -n shop catalog-6b8cf764b7-xvrnl --all-containers=true` (diag-k8s): exit code 1, `container "catalog" ... is waiting to start: trying and failing to pull image`. The container never started, so there are no application logs.

FIX (not applied): change the image of Deployment `catalog` in namespace `shop` from `docker.io/library/nginx:1.99` to an existing tag, for example `docker.io/library/nginx:1.27-alpine` (the tag the `search` deployment already runs on this cluster), then confirm the new pod pulls the image.

Fact.Name: cause
Fact.Value: the tag `1.99` does not exist in the registry (`not found`), not a credentials problem
